spans.s: the vital breath, RV. i, 63, 8 (acc. त्म॑नम्), ĀśvŚr. vi, 9, 1 (acc. त्मानम्)
one's own person, self, RV.; ऽत्मन् after ए, or ओ for आत्मन्, KaṭhUp. iii, 12; MBh. i-iii; BhP. vii, 9, 32
उत॑ त्म॑ना or त्म॑नाच ‘and also, and certainly’, इव or न॑ त्म॑ना ‘just as’, अ॑ध त्म॑ना, ‘and even’, RV.

instr. and (at the end of a Pāda) त्म॑न् loc. used as an emphatic particle (like μέν and μήν) ‘yet, really, indeed, even, at least, certainly, also’, RV.; VS. vi, 11; xi, 31; TS. ii, 1, 11, 2; AV. v, 27, 11
only in the Vanas-pati verse of some Āprī hymns = त्म॑ना, i, 188, 10; x, 110, 10; VS. xx, 45; xxix, 10.
